elements.description: A single-response or multiple-response choice interaction.

attributes.name: response-identifier
attributes.description: Identifier of the bound response variable.

attributes.name: max-choices
attributes.description: Maximum selectable choices. `1` is a single-response item; `0` means unlimited and makes it a multiple-response item.

attributes.name: class
attributes.description: QTI shared presentation vocabulary. Space-separated; takes precedence over `orientation`.

attributes.name: correct-response
attributes.description: Answer key. `identifier` of each correct `qti-simple-choice`, comma-separated. One value for a single-response item (`choice3`), several for a multiple-response one (`choice1,choice2,choice4`). Order is not significant.

slots.name: prompt
slots.description: The prompt shown above the choices.

attributes.name: response-identifier
attributes.description: Identifier of the bound response variable.

attributes.name: expected-length
attributes.description: Hint at the expected answer length in characters; sets the textarea's `maxlength`. Also the last-resort row count, used only when neither a `qti-height-lines-*` class nor `expected-lines` is present.

attributes.name: pattern-mask
attributes.description: Regular expression the value must match to be valid.

attributes.name: placeholder-text
attributes.description: Placeholder shown while the textarea is empty.

attributes.name: data-patternmask-message
attributes.description: Custom validation message shown when `pattern-mask` fails. Part of the QTI shared interaction vocabulary.

attributes.name: class
attributes.description: QTI shared presentation vocabulary controlling the rendered height. Outranks both `expected-lines` and `expected-length`.

attributes.name: expected-lines
attributes.description: Expected number of lines of response, and the rendered row count unless a `qti-height-lines-*` class is present.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: How the response is presented. `preformatted` renders the field monospaced; `xhtml` is accepted but downgraded to plain, because the field is a textarea with no rich-text editor behind it.

attributes.name: correct-response
attributes.description: Model answer, NOT a machine-scorable key. Free prose cannot be compared to an expected string, so nothing in the runtime reads this: the component omits `CorrectResponseMixin` and takes its verdict from outside (a teacher, a marking service, or a model). Write one exemplary answer that demonstrates what full credit looks like, dense with the specific facts, terms and reasoning steps a response must contain — that content is what a rubric is generated from downstream. Do not phrase it as instructions to the candidate, and do not expect an exact-match comparison against it.

slots.name: prompt
slots.description: The prompt shown above the textarea.

elements.description: A gap in the prose, and the first drop target to render its own chips. The interaction owns placement and publishes it on `dragDropContext`; this element subscribes and renders what it holds. Nothing appends into it. That inverts the old flow, where `handleDrop` did `cloneNode` + `appendChild` and the response was recovered afterwards by reading the DOM back out — which is why placement and the response could ever disagree at all. The chips land in this shadow root rather than in the light DOM, so a theme reaches them as `::part(drag)` — a bare `::part()` matches in any shadow root — instead of by tag. The gap's own `:state(filled)` says whether it holds anything.

attributes.name: identifier
attributes.description: Value recorded as the gap side of the response pair.

elements.description: Drag-and-drop gap-match interaction: candidates drag choices into gap targets.

attributes.name: response-identifier
attributes.description: Identifier of the bound response variable.

attributes.name: class
attributes.description: QTI shared presentation vocabulary positioning the gap-choices container.

attributes.name: auto-size-dropzones
attributes.description: Extension, not QTI. Sizes every gap to the widest chip so placement does not reflow the prose.

attributes.name: disable-animations
attributes.description: Extension, not QTI. Disables the FLIP move animation.

attributes.name: correct-response
attributes.description: Answer key. One `gaptext gap` pair per filled gap, space inside the pair and comma between pairs (`ht_zuur gap_low,ht_basisch gap_high`). The `qti-gap-text` identifier comes first and the `qti-gap` identifier second; reversing them scores nothing.

slots.name: prompt
slots.description: The prompt shown above the interaction.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: Default slot for the drop targets (gaps).

elements.description: A draggable text token that fills a `qti-gap` inside `qti-gap-match-interaction`.

attributes.name: identifier
attributes.description: Value recorded in the response pair when this token is placed into a gap.

elements.description: A selectable span of text inside `qti-hottext-interaction`.

attributes.name: identifier
attributes.description: Value recorded in the response when this span is selected.

elements.description: Hottext interaction: candidates select highlighted words within a text block.

attributes.name: response-identifier
attributes.description: Identifier of the bound response variable.

attributes.name: class
attributes.description: QTI shared presentation vocabulary. `qti-unselected-hidden` leaves the selectable words visually indistinguishable from the surrounding prose until they are selected.

attributes.name: correct-response
attributes.description: Answer key. `identifier` of each correct `qti-hottext`, comma-separated (`ht_door` or `ht_door,ht_langs`). Order is not significant.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: Default slot for the mixed content and `qti-hottext` choices.

elements.description: An option in the dropdown of `qti-inline-choice-interaction`.

attributes.name: identifier
attributes.description: Value recorded in the response when this option is selected.

elements.description: Inline choice interaction: dropdown selector rendered inline with surrounding text.

attributes.name: response-identifier
attributes.description: Identifier of the bound response variable.

attributes.name: data-prompt
attributes.description: Placeholder shown before a choice is picked. Falls back to the item configuration's `inlineChoicePrompt`, then to `select`.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Whether a choice must be selected for the response to be valid. Written as `required="true"` / `required="false"`; a bare `required` is accepted too.

attributes.name: correct-response
attributes.description: Answer key. `identifier` of the single correct `qti-inline-choice` (`choice_hoger`).

elements.description: Match interaction: candidates pair items from two sets, either as drag-and-drop or as a tabular grid.

attributes.name: response-identifier
attributes.description: Identifier of the bound response variable.

attributes.name: class
attributes.description: QTI shared presentation vocabulary. `qti-match-tabular` renders a checkbox/radio grid instead of drag-and-drop; the `qti-choices-*` values position the source set.

attributes.name: auto-size-dropzones
attributes.description: Extension, not QTI. Sizes every drop target to the widest chip so placement does not reflow the layout.

attributes.name: disable-animations
attributes.description: Extension, not QTI. Disables the FLIP move animation.

attributes.name: correct-response
attributes.description: Answer key. One `source target` pair per association, space inside the pair and comma between pairs (`left_vermogen right_watt,left_druk right_pascal`). `source` is an identifier from the FIRST `qti-simple-match-set`, `target` from the second — the direction matters. A target whose `match-max` is greater than 1 appears in several pairs (`enzym biologie,mitochondrion biologie`).

slots.name: prompt
slots.description: The prompt shown above the interaction.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: Default slot for the two match sets (drag-and-drop mode).

elements.description: Order interaction: candidates arrange choices into a target sequence.

attributes.name: response-identifier
attributes.description: Identifier of the bound response variable.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Layout direction of the drop sequence. Unlike on `qti-choice-interaction`, QTI does not deprecate this for order.

attributes.name: auto-size-dropzones
attributes.description: Extension, not QTI. Sizes every drop target to the widest chip so placement does not reflow the layout.

attributes.name: disable-animations
attributes.description: Extension, not QTI. Disables the FLIP move animation.

attributes.name: correct-response
attributes.description: Answer key. `identifier` of every `qti-simple-choice` in the one correct sequence, comma-separated (`step_hypothese,step_data,step_conclusies`). Order IS the answer here — unlike every other interaction, reordering these values changes what is correct.

slots.name: prompt
slots.description: The prompt shown above the interaction.

elements.description: Select-point interaction: candidates place points onto a background image.

attributes.name: response-identifier
attributes.description: Identifier of the bound response variable, which must have base-type `point`.

attributes.name: area-mappings
attributes.description: Extension, not QTI. JSON array of `{shape, coords, mappedValue?, defaultValue?}` entries used when no `qti-response-declaration` supplies an `qti-area-mapping`.

attributes.name: correct-response
attributes.description: Answer key. `x y` integer coordinates in the background image's own pixel space, space inside the point and comma between points (`100 150` or `100 150,220 340`). Most point items score by region rather than by exact pixel — prefer a `qti-area-mapping` in the `qti-response-declaration`, or the `area-mappings` attribute, over this.

slots.name: prompt
slots.description: The prompt shown above the image.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: Default slot for the base image.

elements.description: A choice in one of the two match sets of `qti-match-interaction`, or in `qti-associate-interaction`.

attributes.name: identifier
attributes.description: Value recorded in the response pair when this choice participates in an association.

elements.description: A choice, used by `qti-choice-interaction` and `qti-order-interaction`. The `control` part is one box whose *role* is carried by state, not by its name: a radio circle under `:state(radio)`, a checkbox square under `:state(checkbox)`, and a drag grip when the choice is draggable. Style it as `qti-simple-choice::part(control)`.

attributes.name: identifier
attributes.description: Value recorded in the response when this choice is selected, or its position when used for ordering.

elements.description: Text-entry interaction: single-line inline text input.

attributes.name: response-identifier
attributes.description: Identifier of the bound response variable.

attributes.name: expected-length
attributes.description: Hint at the expected answer length; drives the rendered field width and the input's `maxlength`.

attributes.name: pattern-mask
attributes.description: Regular expression the value must match to be valid.

attributes.name: placeholder-text
attributes.description: Placeholder shown while the field is empty.

attributes.name: data-patternmask-message
attributes.description: Custom validation message shown when `pattern-mask` fails. Part of the QTI shared interaction vocabulary.

attributes.name: correct-response
attributes.description: Answer key. The single expected string (`refractie`). Matching is exact unless the response processing template folds case. A value containing a comma cannot be expressed: the codec has no escape and would read it as two answers — use a mapping in the `qti-response-declaration` for multiple accepted answers.
